thread:
mika: Postmortem follow-up: consolidating action items for rollout hardening after last week's incident. Short bullets + owners pls.

harry: I'll take the auto-rollback controller + alert wiring. Plan: implement rollback + a single-step scale-down before rollback. Target: 2025-04-02.

cecil: I'll own blast-radius policy (per-flag active-user limit, per-shard concurrency cap, global kill-switch) and product opt-out flow. Target: 2025-04-09.

mika: Also need routing/sampling fix: sticky routing caused bucket hotspotting. Owner?

harry: I'll do routing change if cecil wants blast-radius. I'll add randomized seeding and a sampling-distribution metric. Target for routing hotfix: 2025-03-28.

sre-bot: system: canary run 2025-02-26T18:40Z  shards=3 concurrency=220 sample_rate=0.05

mika: Proposed emergency rollback rule (draft):
```
if (p95 > 1.6s OR 5xx_rate >= 0.9%) for 180s:
  try scale_down(concurrency*0.5) -> wait 30s -> if still bad rollback()
```
Defaults: prod_concurrency_default=30, nonprod=120. Raising requires risk review and owner sign-off.

cecil: Product/legal note: auto actions must be disclosed in AE contracts; I'll coordinate. Also will prepare a lightweight UX notice for customers when auto-rollback occurs.

harry: I'll add integration test that injects DB queueing and verifies scale-down then rollback ordering. Will open RFC + PR by target date.

mika: Operationally: creating GH board "rollout-hardening" and label `rollout-hardening`. All items must be tickets with owner/due date. Weekly check-in Wednesdays 11am PT.

cecil: Ack, adding telemetry requirements: per-shard qps, active-user counts, shard-entropy. Alert if entropy < threshold.

harry: Corner case: gradual ramp with low sample rate still caused hotspotting due to affinity. I'll also add a sampling QC job in CI to detect skew.

mika: Thanks. If no objections I'll add these as action items on the postmortem and close thread.

cecil: No objections.

harry: LGTM.

mika: Closing and will ping when board is live.
